visual_goal: Show consolidation as a pipeline of dependent steps in two phases: the first four steps decide whether data is fit to consolidate, the next four produce group numbers no single ledger contains.
prompt: A left-to-right pipeline of eight rounded stations joined by single arrows, followed by a result. Each station carries exactly one word, written once above it. The first four stations sit on one soft teal background panel: 'Collect' with a small inbox tray, 'Validate' with a check mark, 'Map' with two linked squares, 'Certify' with a plain round seal holding a check mark. At the end of the teal panel, a small closed padlock sits on the pipe. The next four stations sit on one soft orange background panel: 'Translate' with two coins and a curved swap arrow, 'Ownership' with a pie slice, 'Eliminate' with two opposing arrows cancelling out, 'Adjust' with a pen. At the far right, a larger open book whose pages show only plain grey lines, labeled 'Group numbers'. Exactly eight arrows, one between each neighbouring pair of stations and one from 'Adjust' into 'Group numbers'. The area below the stations is empty.
alt: A pipeline from Collect, Validate, Map and Certify on a teal panel, through a padlock, to Translate, Ownership, Eliminate and Adjust on an orange panel, ending in a book of group numbers.

visual_goal: Show the workflow gate as a state machine whose value is in the transitions that are blocked: rejected loads go back for reload, consolidation needs a lock, a lock needs certification, and an unlock needs an approved reason.
prompt: A state map drawn as stepping stones in a top row running left to right: 'Imported', 'Validated', 'Certified', 'Locked', 'Consolidated', with one straight arrow between each neighbouring pair of stones. The 'Locked' stone carries a padlock and the 'Certified' stone a plain round seal holding a check mark. Directly below 'Imported', a red stone 'Rejected'. 'Imported' and 'Rejected' are joined by a small loop of two short arrows that stay between those two stones: one pointing down from 'Imported' into 'Rejected' and one pointing up from 'Rejected' back into 'Imported'. Directly below 'Locked', a grey stone 'Unlocked' with one arrow pointing down from 'Locked' into it; this arrow carries a small signed tag labeled 'approved reason'. From 'Unlocked' one long arrow runs along the very bottom edge of the picture, passing below 'Rejected', then climbs the far left edge and enters 'Imported' from its left side. Exactly eight arrows.
alt: Stepping stones from Imported through Validated, Certified and Locked to Consolidated, with a Rejected stone looping back to Imported, and an Unlocked stone reached from Locked only with an approved reason, also returning to Imported.

visual_goal: Show OneStream receiving balances, rates, statuses and drivers and sending locked results onward, with detail left in the ledgers and reached by drill-back, and the mapping published to FinDB.
prompt: A left-to-right diagram. At the far left, four inputs stacked vertically: three open ledger books side by side labeled once 'Ledgers'; a box with two currency coins labeled 'Kyriba'; a box with a small green flag labeled 'BlackLine'; a box with a bar chart labeled 'Planning drivers'. Each input sends one arrow right into a large central box labeled 'OneStream' that shows a cube and a padlock. A thin dotted arrow runs from 'OneStream' back left into the 'Ledgers' books, labeled 'drill-back'. At the right, two outputs: one arrow from 'OneStream' to a stack of report documents labeled 'Workiva', and one arrow from 'OneStream' to a database cylinder labeled 'FinDB'; this second arrow carries a small table tag labeled 'mapping'. Exactly seven arrows.
alt: Ledgers, Kyriba rates, a BlackLine certified flag and planning drivers flow into OneStream, which sends locked results to Workiva and its mapping to FinDB, with a dotted drill-back line to the ledgers.

visual_goal: Show that a new source account goes live only after its linked mapping is approved by group reporting in OneStream, and that the same approved mapping reaches FinDB.
prompt: A diagram on a light background. Middle left: a box with a small team of three unlabeled figures labeled 'Brand finance'. Top center: a server box labeled 'Source ERP'. Bottom center: a large box labeled 'OneStream'. Top right: a box with a large green check mark inside it and the words 'Group reporting' written once, above the box. Far right, bottom: a database cylinder labeled 'FinDB'. Arrows: from 'Brand finance' one arrow up-right carrying a document labeled 'New account' into 'Source ERP'; from 'Brand finance' one arrow down-right carrying a document labeled 'Mapping rule' into 'OneStream'; the two documents are joined by a short chain link. One arrow from 'Group reporting' diagonally down-left into 'OneStream'. One green arrow from the top of 'OneStream' straight up into the bottom of 'Source ERP', with a small green traffic light beside it labeled 'go live'. One arrow from 'OneStream' right into 'FinDB', carrying a small table tag labeled 'approved mapping'. 'Source ERP' and 'Group reporting' are not joined. Exactly five arrows. Every label appears exactly once.
alt: Brand finance sends a new account to the source ERP and a linked mapping rule to OneStream; group reporting approves the mapping, OneStream gives the ERP a green light to go live, and the approved mapping goes to FinDB.
